definitions.meaning: Aquileia in Gallia Transpadana, north of the Adriatic

quotations.old_english: Maximus abád æt Aquilegia ðære byrig
quotations.english: Maximus encamped at the town Aquileia

source_text: Aquilegia; indecl. [Aquileia = GREEK] Aquileia in Gallia Transpadana, north of the Adriatic :-- Maximus abád æt Aquilegia ðære byrig Maximus encamped at the town Aquileia, Ors. 6, 36; Bos. 131, 21.
